name: ai-daily-digest
description: Daily AI news digest covering technical advances, business news, and engineering impact, built from dated, verified sources.

interface.shortDescription: Daily AI news digests for engineers and leaders
interface.longDescription: Researches AI news per topic from dated, verified sources, drops stories already covered on earlier days, and writes a curated digest with technical, business, and engineering takeaways to Notion, Obsidian, or a local archive. Explicit invocation only.
defaultPrompt: Run $ai-daily-digest and save it to my Obsidian vault.
